name: aiogram-7a7c3502-blind20-ots
instr:
# aiogram: repairing eighteen silent behaviour regressions without a test suite

A program of mine that talks to a chat service through this library has started misbehaving in a great many small ways at once, and what follows is everything I noticed after moving it onto this checkout. Nothing about the service changed and nothing in my own program changed; the same incoming updates that used to be dealt with correctly now come out wrong, and in several places something that used to work now raises an error instead. The repository has received 18 separate undocumented edits. The failures are spread all over, and several of them sit right next to work that still behaves perfectly.

An update coming in and being routed to whatever of mine should see it goes wrong three ways. The extra information prepared for my callback comes out incomplete: the chat and the person who sent the update are put in place correctly, but the forum topic identifier is missing from it entirely, even though what was worked out plainly carries one, so anything of mine that reads the topic id sees nothing. A condition I wrote as a lazy expression over the incoming values never evaluates at all — an inspection function I embedded in it is never called, and instead of a mapping holding the value under the name I chose, I receive the unevaluated expression itself. And signalling from inside my callback that the current update should be abandoned, with my own explanatory reason, does raise the expected aband
